reliefs.reasoning: Both parties settled their dispute amicably and filed consent terms marked Exh. 'A', leading to the withdrawal and disposal of the complaint.

supplementary_proceedings.reasoning: Respondent failed to comply with the previous order based on consent terms. The complainants sought issuance of warrants under Section 40(1) of RERA, which was allowed by the Authority.

extraction_notes: The primary order dated 17th January 2019 disposed of the complaint as withdrawn based on consent terms. A subsequent non-compliance proceeding dated 26th June 2022 and a recovery warrant issued on 15th June 2023 are also present in the PDF and captured under supplementary proceedings.
